recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any future move to canonical should be handled by a new work-group decision because this issue's final disposition explicitly chose uri for element-path references.
issue_request: FHIR-15883 asked to change Questionnaire.item.definition from url/uri to canonical. The final Published / Not Persuasive with Modification resolution instead kept uri and requested guidance for |version, #path, and above/below behavior using the uri search parameter.
initial_application: Git-svn commit c1932e9ef22bd348c2d15514329b023b59544513 (SVN r14715) applied GF#15883 by changing the Questionnaire spreadsheet datatype from canonical(StructureDefinition) to uri, changing the associated search row from reference to uri, and adding examples including http://example.org/StructureDefinition/Oedema|2.0#Observation.category:XXX.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition keeps Questionnaire.item.definition typed as uri and points to the Questionnaire comments section. The comments section retains the fragment and version examples, while the generated Questionnaire-definition search parameter is type uri and the shared search.html uri section defines :above and :below. Later FHIR-23765 broadened the target to include ObservationDefinition without changing the datatype.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current build already conveys the final disposition and adding duplicate local prose would not change conformance expectations.

related_jiras.note: Allowed Questionnaire.item.definition to reference ObservationDefinition as well as ElementDefinition while preserving the uri datatype.
